name: nemo-fabric-typescript-adapters
description: TypeScript adapter workspace for NVIDIA NeMo Fabric.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace nemo-fabric-adapters-common && npm run build --workspace nemo-fabric-adapters-pi
scripts.pack:check: npm run pack:contents && npm run pack:install-check
scripts.pack:contents: npm run pack:check --workspace nemo-fabric-adapters-common && npm run pack:check --workspace nemo-fabric-adapters-pi
scripts.test: npm run test:units && npm run test:dependencies && npm run pack:check
scripts.test:units: npm test --workspace nemo-fabric-adapters-common && npm test --workspace nemo-fabric-adapters-pi
